briefs.poster:
Design an English event poster, 900 × 1200 px, for AFTER HOURS, an evening of experimental music and listening. It should feel like a distinctive cultural event, with clear information people can use to attend. Art direction, palette, typography and arrangement are yours. Do not imitate an existing artist or venue identity. Do not invent performers, sponsors, extra events or claims. All event data are fictional; mark this discreetly as Demo.

Required information, preserving wording and numbers (capitalization may follow the design):
AFTER HOURS
An evening for open ears
Friday 27 November 2026
19:00–23:00
Relay Hall · 42 Mercer Street
19:00 Doors & listening room
20:00 Tape loops / live set
21:30 The room becomes an instrument
Tickets £18 · Students £10
Limited seating · Step-free access
Come early. Stay curious.

Deliver one finished editable self-contained HTML at output/index.html, a final PNG at output/final.png and a short output/decisions.md. All required wording must remain native HTML or SVG text. Decorative raster imagery is permitted, but the whole composition may not be one raster background. Preserve editable layout. The entire poster must fit 900 × 1200 at 100% with no scrolling or clipped information. Other sizes, interaction and physical printing are outside scope.

The page should establish a distinctive editorial identity, introduce the current issue and make the next screening easy to understand. Art direction, palette, typography and arrangement are yours. All films, people and places below are fictional. Do not imply an actual film still or venue photograph; invented illustration is allowed. Mark demo content discreetly. No extra titles, reviews, statistics, logos or promotional claims.

briefs.operations:
Design a static English operations screen for ROUTE ROOM, used by a small coach terminal's departure coordinator. Desktop 1440 × 900, one screen without scrolling. A coordinator must scan all six departures, see what needs attention, and understand the selected departure's current situation. Aim for a strong, purposeful visual identity and readable operational information. Art direction, palette, typography and arrangement are yours. All data are fictional; mark this discreetly as Demo. Do not invent metrics, routes, passengers, statuses or events. This is a visual prototype; no actions run.
